articles.title: Rock Star Jack Antonoff Says Everyone Agrees: 'This Version of Modernity Is Trash'
articles.summary: Jack Antonoff, the guy behind the band Bleachers, says his new album is about how we all feel a little lost and lonely today. He thinks everyone secretly agrees that modern life is kind of a mess.

articles.title: That Catchy Kars4Kids Jingle Might Disappear in California—Here's the Wild Reason Why
articles.summary: A judge in California banned the famous Kars4Kids ad because it didn't tell people the money mostly goes to a Jewish charity far away. One man donated his car thinking he was helping local kids and felt tricked.

articles.title: This Artist Feeds Pistachios to Crows and Finds Joy After Loss
articles.summary: Kevin Callahan lost his partner of 39 years and moved to a new home with a tiny studio. Now, he paints small, jewel-like pictures and makes friends with neighborhood birds by sharing pistachios.
